# pve_cluster_jobs (Data Source)

Cluster jobs index and configured realm-sync jobs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_cluster_jobs" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: .
- `jobs` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/jobs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jobs))
- `realm_sync_jobs` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/jobs/realm-sync. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--realm_sync_jobs))

<a id="nestedatt--jobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jobs`

Read-Only:

- `subdir` (String) API sub-directory endpoint


<a id="nestedatt--realm_sync_jobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `realm_sync_jobs`

Read-Only:

- `api_id` (String) The ID of the entry.
- `comment` (String) A comment for the job.
- `enabled` (Boolean) If the job is enabled or not.
- `last_run` (Number) Last execution time of the job in seconds since the beginning of the UNIX epoch
- `next_run` (Number) Next planned execution time of the job in seconds since the beginning of the UNIX epoch.
- `realm` (String) Authentication domain ID
- `remove_vanished` (String) A semicolon-separated list of things to remove when they or the user vanishes during a sync. The following values are possible: 'entry' removes the user/group when not returned from the sync. 'properties' removes the set properties on existing user/group that do not appear in the source (even custom ones). 'acl' removes acls when the user/group is not returned from the sync. Instead of a list it also can be 'none' (the default).
- `schedule` (String) The configured sync schedule.
- `scope` (String) Select what to sync.
